title: Pediatric Hearing Treatment Clinical Simulation
program: Speech-Language Pathology Program, Department of Rehabilitation and Movement Sciences
source: Rubric for Pediatric Treatment (organizer file, evaluation rubrics folder)
pointsNote: The faculty rubric assigns points to the four sections only. Within a section the points are divided equally between its numbered items, and a numbered item's sub-items share that item's points equally. This division is an implementation choice, not faculty wording.

criteria.text: Use professional and empathetic language throughout the session

sections.title: Engage in a Needs Assessment with the client

criteria.text: Review with the client: age at diagnosis of deafness
Review with the client: device use
Ask about any other auditory complaints (tinnitus, hyperacusis, etc)
Ask about the most important communication challenge/need today

sections.title: Review the client's audiogram with them

criteria.text: Explain the severity of the client's hearing loss in a sensitive manner
Using the Speech Banana, explain what the client can hear with and without their hearing technology

sections.title: Discuss realistic expectations for aural rehabilitation

criteria.text: Explain the difference between an audiologist and an SLP
Explain what aural rehab is and how it can help
Express empathy for the challenge(s) faced by the client
Answer any questions the client has
